code:
from sklearn.ensemble import VotingRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from xgboost import XGBRegressor

voting_model = VotingRegressor(estimators=[
    ("ridge", Ridge(alpha=1.0)),
    ("forest", RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=300, max_depth=6)),
    ("xgb", XGBRegressor(n_estimators=300, learning_rate=0.03, max_depth=3)),
])
voting_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
caption: VotingRegressor fits all base models and averages their predictions, optionally with explicit weights.

code:
from sklearn.ensemble import StackingRegressor

stacking_model = StackingRegressor(
    estimators=[
        ("ridge", Ridge(alpha=1.0)),
        ("forest", RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=300, max_depth=6)),
        ("xgb", XGBRegressor(n_estimators=300, max_depth=3)),
    ],
    final_estimator=Ridge(alpha=1.0),
    cv=5,  # use a walk-forward/purged splitter on real data
)
stacking_model.fit(X_train, y_train)
caption: StackingRegressor trains a meta-model to learn how to weight each base model's out-of-fold predictions.
